messages:
Nina Park: FYI eu2-rack42 reported 90% alloc saturation on gpu-pool-b and intermittent tail latency spikes starting 08:07. Looks like multiple tenants trying to burst pre-warm at once.

Diego Morales: saw that. Telemetry shows 3 tenants with sustained egress ~300-600MB/s each + a fourth doing large offline batches. NIC queues Q2/3 congested.

Nina Park: Tenant ids? any dedicated allocations?

Diego Morales: tid-1102 (analytics), tid-4450 (customer A), tid-9900 (internal), tid-7711 (scheduled batch). Only tid-4450 has a small reserved slice.

InfraBot: ALERT eu2-rack42: pool_gpu_util 0.92, nic_tx 1.6GB/s, slab_evictions +260% over baseline. Created ticket INC-9024.

Harpreet Singh: If multiple tenants burst at same time, our soft-affinity algorithm sometimes fills same rack. We should rebalance fractional-dedicated allocations across racks when egress>threshold.

Zoe Kim: agree. Short-term: can we set pack_throttle to spread warmups? Exists as allocator knob: `pack_throttle_ms`.

Diego Morales: quick mitigation:
```
allocatorctl set-rack-policy --rack=eu2-rack42 --pack_throttle_ms=3000 --egress_headroom_mb=800
```
This staggers new warm allocations and sets headroom.

Nina Park: apply and monitor. Also add a routing fallback to prefer eu2-rack50/51 for new fractional allocations when rack42 egress>1GB/s.

InfraBot: ACTION scheduled: applying rack policy.

(1m) InfraBot: policy applied. Live metrics: https://telemetry.redwood/eu2/rack42/INC-9024

Harpreet Singh: initial effect: allocation churn down 40%, tail latency improving for tid-1102 and tid-9900. tid-7711 batch still spikes NIC bursts during run window.

Zoe Kim: for tid-7711 we should recommend shifting scheduled batch to off-peak or request temporary dedicated capacity. Also flag them for cost-awareness: bursting like this on shared racks increases SLO risk for others.

Diego Morales: Agreed. Propose policy: if rack_egress > 1.2GB/s and pool_gpu_util > 0.85 for >5m, automatically divert new fractional allocations to alternate racks and send customer-facing note with mitigation options.

Nina Park: please add automation ticket and a short ops playbook step. I'll draft a billing note offering short-term reserved slices (discounted) vs. migration.

InfraBot: NOTE automation task created: AUTO-2248.

Harpreet Singh: one more thing 12: region constraint: eu2 has limited spare racks this week due to maintenance windows. Ensure fallback racks have enough headroom before auto-divert.

Nina Park: noted. We'll gate auto-divert on target_rack_headroom >= 1200MB. Closing after 20m steady. :white_check_mark:
